title: Kenney Racing
sections: Race 3 laps against three computer drivers and cross the finish line first. In time trial you race alone against a see-through ghost of your best lap time on that track.
Drag on the left half of the screen and point where the truck should go: it turns that way and drives. Push further for more speed. REVERSE backs up when you're stuck against a fence. II pauses.

Drive over the orange arrow pads for a burst of speed. Hold the stick to the side through a long bend, then straighten: the drift gives a small boost. Be on the stick the moment GO appears for a start boost.

Drive through a blue ? box to get an item, then tap ITEM. Mushroom: a boost. Banana: dropped behind you, whoever hits it spins out. Shell: flies at the driver ahead of you. Drivers at the back get more mushrooms.

Race: one track. Time trial: your best time and ghost are saved per track. Cup: all five tracks in a row, 10 / 6 / 3 / 1 points for 1st to 4th. Difficulty (Easy, Normal, Hard) sets how fast the others drive.
Each race scores points for your place and your time; winning counts as a win in the Arcade.
